messages:
sam: Hey infra — requesting quota + project approval for a new project `redwood-research-2` under the org `redwood-prod`. Need GPUs for an eval run:
- A100 80GB: +8 GPUs in us-central1 (on-demand)
- L4: +4 GPUs in us-west1 (we can use preemptibles here if cheaper)
Also need external IP quota +10 and increase in routes/firewall throughput for that project. Timeline: start Mon, will run ~24/7 for ~3 weeks. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/home/dashboard?project=redwood-research-2

infra-bot: Ticket INFRA-3245 created for quota request and project approval. Please include billing account and expected sustained core-hours. Assigned to eng-infra oncall.

julian: who is the billing account? also confirm whether A100s must be non-preemptible. org policy might block GPUs in some folders; we may need admin exception.

sam: billing account is `Redwood-Shared-Billing` (billing ID: B-012345). A100s need to be non-preemptible for stability during long evals; L4s we can try preemptible. Estimated GPU-hours: A100s ~8 * 24 * 21 = 4032 GPU-hours, L4 preemptible ~4 * 12 * 21 = 1008 (we expect less sustained due to preemptions).

anna: can you add a short justification paragraph for the quota form? Google asks for peak and sustained usage and business impact. Also, do you need TPU quota too or just GPUs?

sam: quick justification: "Performance regression tests and model calibration for release candidate RC-4 require dedicated A100 capacity to reproduce long-sequence workloads. Failure to get capacity will delay release by 2 weeks and block benchmark publishing." No TPU needed right now.

maria: network check — do you need VPC peering to prod VPC or will this be isolated? If peering, request for additional routes and increase in Cloud NAT ephemeral ports might be needed. Also confirm external IP count (+10 requested) and whether we can use internal-only for some hosts.

sam: preference is isolated VPC but we will peer read-only to metrics prod VPC for Prometheus scraping. So we need 5 extra routes and +10 external IPs for bastions + diagnostics. We can reduce external IPs if needed but prefer to keep them.

julian: next steps for me: I can submit the GCP quota request form but need the following in the body: project ID, billing account, justification (paste from above), sustained and peak numbers, preferred regions, and contact info. sam, please paste contact phone/email.

sam: contact: sam@redwood.ai, pager: +1-555-0202. Put priority as P2 — timeline tight but not an outage.

sre-oncall: FYI SRE: please note we'll see increased egress to monitoring endpoints. Recommend we pre-create firewall rules and a small test cluster to validate boot scripts. I can help tomorrow at 09:30 PT.

infra-bot: INFRA-3245 updated: julian added details, escalated to GCP quota team. GCP request ID: Q-2026-8892. Expected initial review in 24-48h.

julian: submitted the form. For reproducibility I included the gcloud check command we used to validate current quotas:
```
# check current quotas
gcloud compute regions describe us-central1 --project=redwood-research-2 --format="yaml(quotas)"
```

maria: added a short note for networking team about Cloud NAT ephemeral ports and VPC peering. Linking internal doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/networking/vpc-peering-guidelines

sam: thanks all. if quota approved, i will open a deploy runbook PR and tag @sre-oncall for the pre-create steps.

infra-bot: GCP quota team responded: Q-2026-8892 - pending org admin approval for GPUs in folder `research`. Action required: Org Admin must approve GPU deployments in that folder or exception must be granted. Please escalate to @ops-admins.

julian: pinging ops-admins separately. tagging here for trace. If admins approve, final step is billing verification from finance.

sre-oncall: noted — I'll reserve a small canary A100 instance once quotas show as granted so we can validate kernel/driver stack and NVSwitch configs.

infra-bot: INFRA-3245 status: awaiting org admin sign-off. Last update 1765432460."
